# 16025: Dial->Conference: Participant label is in use by another participant

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 16025

[error-16025 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#error-16025)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The participant label specified as an attribute on the conference noun in twiml is already in use by another active participant in the same conference.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

1. The same static twiml specifying a participant label was served to two difference calls
2. Dynamically generated twiml specified the same participant label for two different calls
3. The participant label specified in the twiml Is the same as one specified for an outbound participant that was already added to the conference using the Twilio API

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Use a label value which uniquely identifies this participant within the conference

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16028#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

# 16110: Internal failure when bulk deleting recordings from your account

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 16110

[error-16110 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#error-16110)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Despite our best efforts, we have failed to delete some or all of the selected recordings. The operation has been cancelled.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

There was an internal failure when processing your request. This action will not be retried.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Please retry the delete operation with the same parameters.
- If the error persists, please [contact us](https://www.twilio.com/help/contact "contact us") to figure out what has happened and how to fix it!
- Note the time of the error and which filter was used to select the recordings.

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16111#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio failed to upload the recording file to the external AWS S3 bucket specified in Voice Settings due to an invalid configuration. The recording file has been deleted, and if the resource exists, the resource has been marked as "failed".

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16111#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure AWS S3 bucket credentials are valid and available in Credential Storage
- Set a valid S3 bucket URL
- Disable external storage
- Ensure External Storage settings are provided for each home region you want to use

- If SSE-S3 is enabled, please consider switching to SSE-KMS
- Disable external storage

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17000#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

This error code is returned when an account is trying to access a resource created by another account. Note: parent accounts can access subaccount resources, but subaccounts cannot access parent account resources, or other subaccounts under the same parent account.

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17000#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

This error code is also returned when an account is attempting to access a resource where Voice Insights Advanced Features has not been enabled on that account.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17000#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Once enabled future calls will be retrievable via API.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 17001

[error-17001 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#error-17001)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

This error code is returned by the /Summary API when a completed summary is requested and it doesn't exist.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The call SID for the call is valid, but the call summarization process was not complete at the time of the request. Summarization takes 30 minutes to complete.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

To see results immediately, use the ProcessingState=partial query parameter, which will return a 200, but the response will contain only a partial or incomplete information until the summarization is completed.

# 17400: Invalid query parameter

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 17400

[error-17400 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#error-17400)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Invalid query parameter has been passed in the request.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Invalid format for country code, SIP URI, Client address, or phone number. Wildcard searches.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Utilize only two-character country code; e.g. US Do not attempt wildcard searches; e.g. from=+1206\* Use E.164 address format for telephone numbers; e.g. +14258675309 Use SIP URI format; e.g. sip:user@domain.com Use Client address format; e.g. client:username

# 18004: Redactions in document.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 18004

[error-18004 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18004#error-18004)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PHONE NUMBERS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18004#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The supporting document you submitted had redactions or covered information that is required for the regulatory requirement.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18004#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Uploading a document with obscured or redacted information.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18004#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Re-upload the Supporting Document without any redactions or covered portions. For any ID document, make sure to provide a color copy of the ID document without any reductions. Make sure that all the edges of the ID document and MRZ data for passports are visible.

# 18021: Name mismatch (Proof of Address)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 18021

[error-18021 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18021#error-18021)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PHONE NUMBERS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18021#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The individual's name on the Proof of Address document does not match the information entered in the Bundle.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18021#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The name on the Proof of Address document does not match what's submitted in the first name / last name fields. Please ensure the document and field information match.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18021#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Please ensure the names match exactly and that all the individual's last names are provided. Please amend firstly the name in the Business & legal representative information / Individual information section of the bundle, and then in the Bundle fields under the uploaded supporting document.

# 18052: Under age Individual

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 18052

[error-18052 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18052#error-18052)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PHONE NUMBERS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18052#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

We do not permit underage individuals on our platform.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18052#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The Authorized Representative's age is under 18 years, which is considered underage to use Twilio's products.

### Possible Solutions

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18609#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Please resubmit your registration using either an EIN or a DUN number.

# 19021: Only one channel can be set as primary

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 19021

[error-19021 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19021#error-19021)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19021#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

is\_primary can be set to true only for one channel

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19021#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Request with is\_primary set to True for more than one channel

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19021#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Ensure only each channel has only 1 is\_primary set to true

# 19023: Invalid channel type

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 19023

[error-19023 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#error-19023)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE MESSAGING

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Request with an invalid channel type

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- If you are sending rich content and are receiving this error when a message fallback is occurring, a content type that is not supported on the fallback message channel is being used.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- If you are sending rich content such as a card, ensure you also define a twilio/text translation for SMS fallback or twilio/media translation for MMS fallback.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 19028

[error-19028 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19028#error-19028)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19028#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Channel value can not be updated

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19028#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The channel value provided in the request is different from the existing one

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19028#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Remove channel value from the request or Delete the existing channel and create a then new one with the new value

# 20003: Permission Denied

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20003

[error-20003 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#error-20003)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

#### Authenticating requests to the Twilio API

[authenticating-requests-to-the-twilio-api page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#authenticating-requests-to-the-twilio-api)

All requests to sensitive areas of the Twilio API must use [HTTP Basic Authentication(link takes you to an external page)](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basic_access_authentication "HTTP Basic Authentication"). Authenticate using your Account SID as the username, and your Auth Token as the password. Both can be found in the [Twilio Console](https://www.twilio.com/console/account/settings "Twilio Console").

You can also generate revocable [API Keys](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/keys/api-key "API Keys") to authenticate.

You may want to consider using a [Twilio helper library](https://www.twilio.com/docs/libraries "Twilio helper library") (available in PHP, .NET, Java, Ruby, Python and Node.js) as they will take care of authentication for you.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Using the wrong combination of Account SID and Auth Token
- Using Test Credentials to access your Live Account
- Using subaccount credentials to access master account
- Previous Auth Token has been deleted
- Attempted API Key has been deleted
- Account is suspended or closed
- Extra characters or spaces in the supplied credentials
- Web proxy is stripping out credentials before forwarding to Twilio
- Using JWT with Auth Token rather than API Key
- Attempted API Key is for the incorrect Twilio Region

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Verify the Account SID and Auth Token are correct
- Verify the correct Account is being accessed
- Ensure the Account is active, not suspended or closed
- Ensure no extra characters or spaces are being included
- Ensure JWT is only used with API Key
- Ensure the API Key's Twilio Region matches the request's specified Twilio Region

# 20009: Cannot delete this resource before it is complete

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20009

[error-20009 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20009#error-20009)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20009#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to delete a call or message resource before it was completed. If you are attempting to delete a call, wait until the call is completed and try your request again. If you are attempting to delete a message, wait several minutes and try again.

If you're seeing a message in the logs that you have already deleted, please allow up to 14 days for our systems to completely remove this record before reaching out to support.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20009#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- You requested the call or message be deleted before all of Twilio's systems finished processing it.
- In rare cases, a message or call record may take up to 14 days to be finalized and able to be deleted.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20009#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- If you are attempting to delete a call, verify that the call is not still in-progress.
- If you are attempting to delete a call or message shortly after sending or receiving it, please wait at least 1 minute to make your DELETE request. If you receive this error after waiting 1 minute, wait several minutes and retry deletion again.
- If you encounter this issue frequently even when waiting several minutes before deleting a message or a completed call, please [contact Twilio support(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/console/support/tickets/create "contact Twilio support") with examples of affected Call or Message SIDs.
- For the highest level of privacy for Twilio SMS messages, apply for [message redaction(link takes you to an external page)](https://ahoy.twilio.com/message-redaction "message redaction") which can automatically redact message bodies or phone numbers immediately after a message is sent or received.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

## Error Code 20012

[error-code-20012 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20012#error-code-20012)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Invalid TLSv1.2 Cipher Suite

[invalid-tlsv12-cipher-suite page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20012#invalid-tlsv12-cipher-suite)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The request was rejected because it was not correctly configured to use TLSv1.2. All new accounts are [required to use TLSv1.2 with supported ciphers suites(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/360007724794 "required to use TLSv1.2 with supported ciphers suites").

#### Possible Solutions:

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20012#possible-solutions)

- Reconfigure request to use a supported cipher suite for TLSv1.2
- Review these [tips for upgrading your environment to TLSv1.2(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/360006751753 "tips for upgrading your environment to TLSv1.2")

#### Supported Cipher Suites:

[supported-cipher-suites page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20012#supported-cipher-suites)

- TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_128\_GCM\_SHA256 (ecdh\_x25519) - A
- TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_128\_CBC\_SHA256 (ecdh\_x25519) - A
- TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_128\_CBC\_SHA (ecdh\_x25519) - A
- TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_256\_GCM\_SHA384 (ecdh\_x25519) - A
- TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_256\_CBC\_SHA384 (ecdh\_x25519) - A
- TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_256\_CBC\_SHA (ecdh\_x25519) - A
- TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_128\_GCM\_SHA256 (rsa 2048) - A
- TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_128\_CBC\_SHA256 (rsa 2048) - A
- TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_128\_CBC\_SHA (rsa 2048) - A
- TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_256\_GCM\_SHA384 (rsa 2048) - A
- TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_256\_CBC\_SHA256 (rsa 2048) - A
- TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_256\_CBC\_SHA (rsa 2048) - A
- TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_3DES\_EDE\_CBC\_SHA (rsa 2048) - C

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20012#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Supported Cipher Suites list is not reflecting the reality.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions-1 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20012#possible-solutions-1)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Changed with the real list which is checked

# 20103: Invalid Access Token issuer/subject

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20103

[error-20103 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20103#error-20103)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PLATFORM

ERROR

# Error - 20103

* * *

## Invalid Access Token issuer or subject

[invalid-access-token-issuer-or-subject page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20103#invalid-access-token-issuer-or-subject)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The issuer or subject of the Access Token provided to the Twilio API was invalid.

**Issuer:** The [API Key](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/rest/keys "API Key") used to sign the the token.

**Subject:** The Twilio Account SID from your [Live Credentials](https://www.twilio.com/console/account/settings "Live Credentials").

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20103#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Account is inactive or suspended.
- Account SID is incorrect.
- API Key is incorrect or has been deleted.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20103#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure the account is active and there are enough funds available.
- Ensure the Account SID is correct and is from your Live Credentials.
- Make sure that the API Key used to sign the request is correct and associated with the supplied Account SID.

To check whether the Access Token is structurally correct, you can use the tools available at [jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "jwt.io").

Access Tokens are used by multiple Twilio SDKs, including Programmable Voice, Programmable Video, and Programmable Chat. For the details of Twilio's specific Access Token implementation and the requirements of the issuer and subject fields, see [the documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/rest/access-tokens "the documentation").

# Warning - 20104

* * *

## Access Token has expired or expiration date is invalid

[access-token-has-expired-or-expiration-date-is-invalid page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20104#access-token-has-expired-or-expiration-date-is-invalid)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The Access Token provided to the Twilio API has expired, the expiration time specified in the token was invalid, or the expiration time specified was too far in the future.

Access Token expiration times can be set up to 24 hours in the future.

To check whether the Access Token is structurally correct, you can use the tools available at [jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "jwt.io").

Access Tokens are used by multiple Twilio SDKs, including Programmable Voice, Programmable Video, and Programmable Chat. For the details of Twilio's specific Access Token implementation, see [the documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/rest/access-tokens "the documentation").

# Error - 20105

* * *

## Access Token not yet valid

[access-token-not-yet-valid page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20105#access-token-not-yet-valid)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The Access Token provided to the Twilio API is not yet valid.

Twilio Access Tokens are generated with a `nbf` field that determines the start of the token's lifetime. Normally this is set to the current time when the token is generated; check whether your computer's clock has drifted.

To check whether the Access Token is structurally correct, you can use the tools available at [jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "jwt.io").

For the details of Twilio's specific Access Token implementation and the requirements of the issuer and subject fields, see [the documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/rest/access-tokens "the documentation").

# 20107: Invalid Access Token signature

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

## ERROR: 20107

[error-20107 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20107#error-20107)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PLATFORM

ERROR

# Error - 20107

* * *

## Invalid Access Token signature

[invalid-access-token-signature page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20107#invalid-access-token-signature)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The signature for the Access Token provided was invalid.

Check that your code is correctly generating signatures using the algorithm and format expected by the Twilio API.

To check whether the Access Token is structurally correct, you can use the tools available at [jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "jwt.io").

Access Tokens are used by multiple Twilio SDKs, including Programmable Voice, Programmable Video, and Programmable Chat. For the details of Twilio's specific Access Token implementation, see [the documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/rest/access-tokens "the documentation").

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20107#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- The supplied Account SID, API Key or API Secret is incorrect.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20107#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure you're using the correct Account SID for your [Live API Credentials](https://www.twilio.com/console/account/settings "Live API Credentials").
- Verify the API Key was generated for the same account as the supplied Account SID. (The API Secret is not the same as the Account Auth Token.)
- Verify the API Secret is correct for the API Key being used and that no extra characters are included.
- Check if the API Secret passes signature validation when used at [jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "jwt.io").
- Generate a new API Key and Secret for the Account SID and try again.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Invalid Issuer Or Subject

[invalid-issuer-or-subject page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20153#invalid-issuer-or-subject)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The issuer or subject of the JWT provided to the Twilio API was invalid.

#### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20153#possible-causes)

- The issuer is missing from JWT
- The issuer entity is suspended in Twilio.
- The subject is missing from JWT
- The subject entity is suspended in Twilio.
- The issuer and subject are not related.

#### Possible Solution:

[possible-solution page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20153#possible-solution)

- In case of Public Key Client Validation, make sure the account and the API key are valid and not suspended.
- For the details on JWTs used as part of Public Key Client Validation, see [the documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/credentials/public-key-client-validation-getting-started "the documentation")
- To check whether the JWT is structurally correct, you can use the tools available at jwt.io.

# 20154: Invalid Claim Set

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20154

[error-20154 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20154#error-20154)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PLATFORM

ERROR

* * *

## Error - 20154

[error---20154 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20154#error---20154)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Invalid Claim Set

[invalid-claim-set page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20154#invalid-claim-set)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The JWT could be parsed, but the claims in the payload section are invalid.

#### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20154#possible-causes)

- One of the required claims is missing.

- For JWTs used as part of Public Key Client Validation, we require two custom claims:
  - "hrh" - HTTP headers that were included when calculating the request hash
  - "rqh" - The hash of the HTTP request

#### Possible Solution:

[possible-solution page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20154#possible-solution)

- Make sure you are using the latest Twilio Helper Library
- For the details on JWTs used as part of Public Key Client Validation, see [the documentation](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/credentials/public-key-client-validation-getting-started "the documentation")
- To check whether the JWT is structurally correct, you can use the tools available at jwt.io.

The expiration time provided when creating the JWT exceeds 24 hours, which is the maximum duration allowed.

#### Possible Solution:

[possible-solution page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20157#possible-solution)

- Provide a shorter expiration time, which does not exceed the maximum.

See [the capability token docs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/client/capability-tokens "the capability token docs") to learn more.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

## Error - 20159

[error---20159 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20159#error---20159)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Invalid Signature

[invalid-signature page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20159#invalid-signature)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The JWT provided to the Twilio API has an invalid or mismatching signature.

#### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20159#possible-causes)

- Public key in the JWT does not match the actual private key used for signing the request.

#### Possible Solution:

[possible-solution page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20159#possible-solution)

- Make sure the private key used for signing the JWT matches the public key identifier in JWT.
- To check whether the JWT is structurally correct, you can use the tools available at [jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "jwt.io").

# 20162: A conflicting resource update is in progress

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20162

[error-20162 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20162#error-20162)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PLATFORM

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20162#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The requested resource is already being updated simultaneously by another API request. The last request will be rejected to avoid inconsistent state.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20162#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The same API resource is being updated by multiple simultaneous API requests from different threads in a conflicting fashion.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20162#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Implement an operation retrier and repeat the failed API requests after an interval of time using, exponential backoff algorithm.
- Serialize your API requests that modify the same resources, and wait until the original request completes and returns an API response, before sending any successive modifications.

# 20422: Invalid Parameter

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20422

[error-20422 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20422#error-20422)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Error - 20422

[error---20422 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20422#error---20422)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Invalid Parameter

[invalid-parameter page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20422#invalid-parameter)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The request contained malformed or semantically incorrect parameters.

Common occurrences:

- Lacking a specified `Content-Type` header field
- Invalid or missing XML data
- Invalid parameter type or value

#### Is the request safe to retry?

# 20426: Upgrade Required

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20426

[error-20426 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20426#error-20426)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

# Error - 20426

* * *

## Upgrade Required

[upgrade-required page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20426#upgrade-required)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The server refuses to perform the request using the current protocol but might be willing to do so after the client upgrades to a different protocol.

### TLS and cipher suite upgrade requirements

[tls-and-cipher-suite-upgrade-requirements page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20426#tls-and-cipher-suite-upgrade-requirements)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

In moving towards a more secure posture with regards to [TLS(link takes you to an external page)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transport_Layer_Security "TLS"), we require that all new accounts must use TLS v1.2 or later. All customers must use TLS > 1.2 starting June 26, 2019.

Customers running older operating systems or legacy network software may need to upgrade their systems to be compatible with these changes. If you've received Error 20426, you likely need to upgrade your system.

To learn more about these changes, see our support site's FAQ on [Twilio REST API's TLS and Cipher Suite Security Changes(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/360007820133-FAQ-Twilio-REST-API-s-TLS-and-Cipher-Suite-Security-Changes-for-June-2019 "Twilio REST API's TLS and Cipher Suite Security Changes")

### Tips for upgrading your environment

[tips-for-upgrading-your-environment page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20426#tips-for-upgrading-your-environment)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

To learn more about Twilio's TLS and cipher requirements, please reference [this support article(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/360006751753-Tips-for-Upgrading-Your-Environment-to-Support-Twilio-REST-API-s-TLS-and-Strong-Cipher-Suite-Changes "this support article") where you can learn more about understanding failure signatures, which components to upgrade, and verifying your upgrade.

# 20429: Too many requests

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20429

[error-20429 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20429#error-20429)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PLATFORM

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20429#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio returns this error when your account exceeds allowed concurrency to Twilio's REST API (HTTP 429 Too Many Requests). Requests that receive 429 responses aren't processed and are safe to retry after backing off.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20429#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Excessive concurrent REST API requests from the account, exceeding platform concurrency limits.
- Multiple verification starts initiated in a short period for the same phone number, triggering a concurrency safeguard on Verify endpoints (HTTP 429).
- Built-in Verify attempt limits reached, such as max send attempts or max check attempts, which return HTTP 429.
- Exceeding Verify Service Rate Limits that you configure (for example, per phone number or other keys), enforced when starting verifications.
- Polling verification status above the documented per-minute/hour/day limits.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20429#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Implement retries with exponential backoff; 429 responses are safe to retry.
- Throttle or queue requests to reduce concurrent API calls to Twilio until you remain under concurrency limits.
- For verification flows, avoid repeatedly starting new verifications for the same number; complete the lifecycle by checking the existing verification or allow it to expire before starting another.
- Define and tune Verify Service Rate Limits (for example, per phone number, IP, or session) and pass the appropriate keys when starting verifications.
- Reduce verification status polling to stay within the documented limits.
- Monitor Twilio response headers like Twilio-Concurrent-Requests to understand current load and adjust client behavior.

#### Additional resources

[additional-resources page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20429#additional-resources)

- [API best practices](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/rest-api-best-practices "API best practices")
- [Rate limits and timeouts](https://www.twilio.com/docs/verify/api/rate-limits-and-timeouts "Rate limits and timeouts")
- [Protect your Verify application with Service Rate Limits](https://www.twilio.com/docs/verify/api/programmable-rate-limits "Protect your Verify application with Service Rate Limits")
- [Service Rate Limits](https://www.twilio.com/docs/verify/api/service-rate-limits "Service Rate Limits")
- [Twilio API response Error 429 "Too Many Requests"(link takes you to an external page)](https://help.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/360044308153-Twilio-API-response-Error-429-Too-Many-Requests "Twilio API response Error 429 \"Too Many Requests\"")

# 20500: Internal Server Error

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20500

[error-20500 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20500#error-20500)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Error - 20500

[error---20500 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20500#error---20500)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Internal Server Error

[internal-server-error page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20500#internal-server-error)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The Twilio API encountered an error when processing your request. This generally indicates an error in the server handling logic or a timeout in the API. We apologize for the inconvenience.

#### I'm seeing a lot of these

[im-seeing-a-lot-of-these page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20500#im-seeing-a-lot-of-these)

If you are seeing a consistent pattern of 500 server errors coming from the Twilio API, check our [status page(link takes you to an external page)](http://status.twilio.com/ "status page") for more details. If our status page has no information, [contact support(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/help/contact "contact support") with details about the requests that are failing, and we will investigate.

#### Is the request safe to retry?

[is-the-request-safe-to-retry page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20500#is-the-request-safe-to-retry)

GET and DELETE requests are always safe for you to retry as they are idempotent. Some POST requests are idempotent by nature - purchasing a specific phone number, or hanging up a call - and while these may return different HTTP status codes on each attempt, the end state of the system will be the same whether you make the request one time or ten.

Other POST requests - sending an SMS or triggering an outbound call - are not idempotent. If you get a 500 Server Error on these requests, and you retry the request, it is possible for a customer to receive multiple messages or calls from your application.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21205

[error-21205 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21205#error-21205)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Error - 21205

[error---21205 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21205#error---21205)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Invalid URL

[invalid-url page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21205#invalid-url)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call, but the URL you specified to handle the call was not a valid URL.

If you specified an Application Sid for your outbound phone call, the application must have a valid VoiceUrl or the call will fail.

#### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21205#possible-solutions)

Make sure you submit a fully qualified URL including:

- protocol (http:// or https://)
- hostname
- file path
- properly url-encoded query parameters

Twilio must be able to reach this URL over the public Internet.

# 21206: Invalid SendDigits

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21206

[error-21206 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21206#error-21206)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21206#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call, and you included a `SendDigits` parameter that wasn't valid. `SendDigits` is optional, and specifies that Twilio should simulate sending keypad digits when the party answers. `SendDigits` may contain numbers, the `#` and `*` characters, the letters `A`, `B`, `C`, `D`, as well as lowercase `w` to "wait" for half a second or uppercase `W` to "wait" for a full second.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21206#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The parameter `SendDigits` includes an invalid character.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21206#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Ensure the `SendDigits` parameter only contains the characters: `0123456789ABCD*#wW`.

# 21207: Invalid IfMachine

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21207

[error-21207 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21207#error-21207)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

[error---21207 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21207#error---21207)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Invalid IfMachine

[invalid-ifmachine page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21207#invalid-ifmachine)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call, but you sent an invalid IfMachine parameter. Twilio can determine if an answering machine or voicemail has answered the call, and behave differently if it has. Valid options for IfMachine are "Continue" (continue with the call, progressing after the beep), "Hangup" (immediately hangup the call) or "False" (don't determine if a machine has answered).

# 21210: 'From' phone number not verified

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21210

[error-21210 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21210#error-21210)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21210#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call, but the 'From' number you specified is not a verified number for your account. In order to use a phone number as the Caller ID on outgoing calls, you must first verify your ownership of that phone number.

You can verify phone numbers in the Console [here(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/console/phone-numbers/verified "here").

### Test Credentials

[test-credentials page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21210#test-credentials)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

If you received this error while trying to authenticate with your Test Credentials, you probably tried to make a test call with a `From` number from your live account. The only number that can be used to queue `successful` calls with your Test Credentials is `+15005550006`. For more information, read our documentation on [the `From` number for making calls with your test credentials](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/test-credentials#test-sms-messages-parameters-From).

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21210#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The From number used to make outbound call not a Twilio number or not a verified caller ID

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21210#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

[phone number verification on Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/console/phone-numbers/verified "phone number verification on Console")

# 21211: Invalid 'To' Phone Number

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21211

[error-21211 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21211#error-21211)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21211#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call or send a message, but the `To` phone number you supplied was not a valid phone number or was incorrectly formatted. Twilio accepts phone numbers in [E164 format(link takes you to an external page)](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164 "E164 format"): `[+] [country code] [subscriber number including area code]`.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21211#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- The formatting of the `To` number you supplied was invalid.
- You attempted to send a message or place a call from a Twilio number to itself (i.e. putting the same Twilio number in the `To` and `From` parameters).
- You attempted to send a message to Short Code.
- You attempted to send a message to an Alphanumeric Sender ID.
- You attempted to send a message to a `To` number with an invalid prefix using a Messaging Service.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21211#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure you have formatted your phone numbers in [E164 format(link takes you to an external page)](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164 "E164 format"): `[+] [country code] [subscriber number including area code]`.
- Ensure you have used the correct [country calling code(link takes you to an external page)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_country_calling_codes#Alphabetical_listing_by_country_or_region "country calling code") for the phone number you are calling.
- Ensure you are not attempting to call or message from a Twilio number to itself.
- Ensure you are not attempting to send messages to Short Codes or Alphanumeric Sender IDs. These sender types cannot receive messages from Twilio numbers.
- Review the 'To' number for any typos or incorrect input methods.
- If you are using a third party integration, test your API request in the [Try it out(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/develop/sms/try-it-out/send-an-sms "Try it out") section of the Twilio console. If this is successful, you may need to contact the third party to ensure they are not making unexpected changes to your `To` parameter.
- When sending messages using a Messaging Service, instead of formatting a `To` number with an invalid prefix, remove the prefix and send directly to the `To` number using [E164 format(link takes you to an external page)](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164 "E164 format"): `[+] [country code] [subscriber number including area code]`. If the `To` number is able to accept RCS messages and there is an RCS Agent available in the Messaging Service Sender Pool, it will be selected to send to the given `To` number.

# 21212: Invalid 'From' Number

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21212

[error-21212 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#error-21212)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call or message, but the `From` parameter you supplied was not a valid phone number, Alphanumeric Sender ID or approved WhatsApp Sender.

Twilio accepts phone numbers in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format") (i.e. "+1 format"), 10-digit US and Canadian numbers with any combination of non-digit separators, or Alphanumeric Sender IDs (SMS only) with up to 11 alphanumeric characters \[a-zA-Z0-9\]. Refer to [this page(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223133867-Using-Alphanumeric-Sender-ID-with-Messaging-Services "this page") for acceptable characters.

The number must not be on a do-not-originate (DNO) list, and Alphanumeric Sender IDs may not be generic.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- You have supplied a phone number that was not in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format").
- Your `From` phone number is on a do-not-originate (DNO) list.
- Your [Alphanumeric Sender ID](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-alphanumeric-sender-id "Alphanumeric Sender ID") is blocked or too generic.
- You are trying to use an Alphanumeric Sender ID on Trial Account. Trial accounts [cannot send from Alphanumeric Sender IDs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/guides/how-to-use-your-free-trial-account#sending-sms-and-mms-messages "cannot send from Alphanumeric Sender IDs").
- Your WhatsApp Sender is not approved.
- You attempted to send a message with a `From` number that has an invalid prefix, using a Messaging Service.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure your number is formatted in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format").
- Ensure that your `From` number is assigned and not on a do-not-originate (DNO) list.
- Ensure you are not using an [alphanumeric sender ID](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-alphanumeric-sender-id "alphanumeric sender ID") that is too generic (for example, "SMS" or "INFO").
- If you are getting this error when using a non-generic alphanumeric sender ID, please [submit a support ticket(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/console/support/tickets/create "submit a support ticket") for further assistance.
- If you are using an Alphanumeric Sender ID on a Trial Account, upgrade your account.
- If you are using a WhatsApp Sender, check that your [sender is approved(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/develop/sms/senders/whatsapp-senders "sender is approved") and that you have followed the [onboarding instructions](https://www.twilio.com/docs/whatsapp/tutorial/requesting-access-to-whatsapp "onboarding instructions").
- If you are sending messages using a Messaging Service, and you wish to utilize an RCS Agent in your Sender Pool that falls back to SMS, [send the message from a MessagingServiceSid](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/services#send-a-message-with-a-messaging-service-1 "send the message from a MessagingServiceSid").

# 21216: API: Call blocked by Twilio

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21216

[error-21216 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21216#error-21216)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21216#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The destination number is blocked by Twilio.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21216#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The outbound call to the destination number was blocked by Twilio. Potential causes may be:

- The destination has a high-risk of fraud
- Due to regulatory reasons, the destination cannot be reached
- You are placing a call to a +1 destination and your account is missing a Primary Customer Profile

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21216#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Potential solutions may be:

- If your destination is being incorrectly identified as high-risk of fraud and you have a legitimate need to call this number, please reach out to Twilio Support through the [Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/ "Console") or [Help Center(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us "Help Center").
- If you are placing a call to a +1 destination and your account is missing a Primary Customer Profile, create one in [TrustHub(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/trust-hub/customer-profiles "TrustHub").

# 21220: Invalid call state

# Error - 21232

### Invalid Domain

[invalid-domain page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21232#invalid-domain)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The domain name requested is invalid, already in use or a subdomain of a domain you do not control. This is likely because the parent domain does not exist or because neither the account sid or its parent account controls the parent domain.

# 21235: IP Access Control List Validation Error

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21235

[error-21235 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21235#error-21235)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21235#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

One of the parameters passed when creating or updating an IP Access Control List was incorrect.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21235#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- An IP Access Control List or IP Address with the same FriendlyName may already exist.
- The IP Access Control List may already contain that IP Address

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21235#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Use a different FriendlyName
- Make sure the IP Access Control List does not already contain that IP Address.

# 21240: Credential List Validation Error

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21240

[error-21240 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21240#error-21240)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21240#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

One of the parameters passed when creating or updating a Credential List was incorrect.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21240#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- A Credential List with the same FriendlyName may already exist

- A Username was not provided. A Username must be provided and it must have 32 characters or less

- The password was not provided. A password is required that meets the following criteria:
  - Minimum 12 characters
  - At least one mixed case
  - At least one digit

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21240#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure that your Credential List meets the validation requirements.

# 30034: US A2P 10DLC - Message from an Unregistered Number

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 30034

[error-30034 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30034#error-30034)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE SMS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30034#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Messages sent to US numbers will not be delivered if they are sent from numbers that are not associated with an approved A2P 10DLC Campaign. This [guide(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/4418081745179-How-do-I-check-that-I-have-completed-US-A2P-10DLC-registration- "guide") will help you determine if you have completed registration for A2P 10DLC. To initiate or continue an A2P 10DLC registration, [visit your console here(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/develop/sms/regulatory-compliance/a2p-onboarding "visit your console here"). Find out how to register using [this guide(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/1260801864489-How-do-I-register-to-use-A2P-10DLC-messaging- "this guide").

For a step-by-step walkthrough, check out [this video on resolving Error 30034(link takes you to an external page)](https://twil.io/resolve30034 "this video on resolving Error 30034").

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30034#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You are sending messages to the US using a US 10DLC number that is not associated with an approved A2P 10DLC Campaign.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30034#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Associate your US 10DLC number with a registered A2P Campaign by adding it to the corresponding Messaging Service via the Twilio Console or API. Find out how to register using [this guide(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/1260801864489-How-do-I-register-to-use-A2P-10DLC-messaging- "this guide").

Alternatively, you can also use a different number that is already associated with an approved A2P Campaign to send messages in the US.

# Send templates created with the Content Template Builder

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

This guide explains how to send messages using templates created with the Content Template Builder. You will learn how to configure the necessary fields in your API request and use Messaging Services to send content templates.

To send messages from templates created using the Content Template Builder, include two new fields in your API request. First, configure a [Messaging Service](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/services "Messaging Service") and [create your content template](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/create-templates-with-the-content-template-builder "create your content template").

* * *

## New content fields used to send messages

[new-content-fields-used-to-send-messages page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/send-templates-created-with-the-content-template-builder#new-content-fields-used-to-send-messages)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You will use the existing messaging endpoint with an additional field, `ContentSid`. You may also include the `ContentVariables` field to substitute any placeholder values in your templates.

Copy code block

```

```

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ContentSid` | Yes | String field used to identify the preconfigured content. Required to send templates created using the Content Template Builder. |
| `ContentVariables` | No | JSON string used to define the values of any placeholder variables found in the preconfigured content. Key-value pairs of placeholder variable names and substitution values. Content templates support up to 100 key-value pairs per send request. |

(information)

## Info

If you are sending a WhatsApp message outside the 24-hour free-form session, you need to use a template approved by WhatsApp. To learn more, see [Content API quick start](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/create-and-send-your-first-content-api-template "Content API quick start").

* * *

# twilio/quick-reply

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

The `twilio/quick-reply` content type lets recipients tap, rather than type, to respond to a message. You can include up to ten quick-reply buttons. When you send an in-session WhatsApp message that does **not** require template approval, only three buttons are allowed.

(warning)

## Warning

`twilio/quick-reply` content templates can be sent over WhatsApp for out-of-session messages that include variables. If the template body starts or ends with a variable, or if two variables appear adjacent to each other, WhatsApp will reject the template. A sample value for each variable is required. For details, see [Using Variables with Content Templates](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/using-variables-with-content-api "Using Variables with Content Templates").

* * *

## Supported channels

[supported-channels page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/twilio-quick-reply#supported-channels)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- WhatsApp
- Facebook Messenger

* * *

## Message preview

[message-preview page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/twilio-quick-reply#message-preview)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

| ![Chat options: Check Flight Status, Check Gate Number, Speak with an Agent.](https://www.twilio.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs-resources.prod.twilio.com%2F3e2a5c43d23f991c60d5b8bb868f114d1434406c8347038e72d30a360556288a.png&w=1080&q=75)Expand image | ![Chat from Owl Air Support offering options to check flight status, gate number, or see all options.](https://www.twilio.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs-resources.prod.twilio.com%2F638b380283b8d489512fb3a33d0174f17f17c04aa00dbc5f6c0cad3154ff691d.png&w=1080&q=75)Expand image | ![Menu with options for flight status, gate number, agent contact, and weather at DEP and ARR.](https://www.twilio.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs-resources.prod.twilio.com%2Fb2fddf1a4ea91b70a59e1c1843e40f9ee2ef6f5b2a9171e9d5597fbd198c15d8.png&w=1200&q=75)Expand image |

## Data parameters

[data-parameters page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/twilio-quick-reply#data-parameters)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

| Parameter | Type | Required | [Variable support](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/using-variables-with-content-api "Variable support") | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | string | Yes | Yes | Text that appears above the quick-reply buttons.<br>Maximum length: 1,024 characters. |
| `actions` | array | Yes | Yes | An array that contains between 1 and 10 quick-reply buttons. |

### `actions` properties

# Access Tokens

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

Access Tokens are short-lived tokens that you use to authenticate Twilio client-side SDKs like [Voice](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/sdks "Voice"), [Conversations](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations "Conversations"), [Sync](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sync/sync-sdk-download "Sync"), and [Video](https://www.twilio.com/docs/video/platform-sdk-support-policy "Video").

You create them on your server to verify a user's identity and grant access to client API features. All tokens have a limited lifetime, configurable for up to 24 hours. However, a best practice is to generate Access Tokens for the shortest amount of time feasible for your application.

* * *

## Contents

[contents page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#contents)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- [Anatomy of an Access Token](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#token-anatomy "Anatomy of an Access Token")
- [How to create Access Tokens](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#creating-tokens "How to create Access Tokens")
  - [Conversations](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-conversations "Conversations")
  - [Voice](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-voice "Voice")
  - [Video](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-video "Video")
  - [Sync](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-sync "Sync")
- [Managing Access Token lifecycle](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#managing-lifecycle "Managing Access Token lifecycle")

* * *

## Anatomy of an Access Token

[token-anatomy page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#token-anatomy)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Each Access Token is a [JSON Web Token(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "JSON Web Token") (JWT), an encoded JSON object with three parts: the header, the payload, and the signature. The following is an example Access Token generated for Conversations.

Copy code block

```

```

If you inspect it [with the debugger at jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "with the debugger at jwt.io"), you can further explore its content.

### Header

[jwt-header page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#jwt-header)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Copy code block

```

```

The `header` section encodes the format of the token:

- `typ` is the type of token. Its value **must** be `"JWT"`.
- `alg` is the algorithm used to encode the token. Its value **must** be `"HS256"`.
- `cty` is the content type and encodes the version of the Access Token. Its value **must** be `"twilio-fpa;v=1"`.

### Payload

[payload page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#payload)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Copy code block

```

```

The `payload` section describes the authorization granted:

- `jti` is a unique identifier for the token. Your application can choose this identifier. The default SDK implementation includes the SID of the API key used to generate the token and a unique random string.
- `iss` is the issuer — the API key containing the secret used to sign the token.
- `sub` is the SID of the Twilio Account to which access is scoped.
- `iat` is the timestamp at which the token was issued.
- `nbf` is an optional timestamp, before which the token will NOT be accepted.
- `exp` is the timestamp at which the token will expire. Tokens have a maximum age of 24 hours.
- `grants` is the list of permissions that the token grants. Grant properties and values will depend on the Twilio product and the needs of your specific use case.

### Signature

[signature page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#signature)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The `signature` section is a signed hash that serves to prove the authenticity of the token. It is the result of hashing the JWT header and payload together with your API key secret, which should only be known to your application and Twilio.

* * *

## Create Access Tokens

[creating-tokens page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#creating-tokens)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio Access Tokens are based on the [JSON Web Token(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "JSON Web Token") standard.

You can use one of Twilio's SDKs to create Access Tokens quickly and programmatically.

### Step 1: Find your Account SID

[step-1-account-sid page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#step-1-account-sid)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Every Access Token requires your Account SID, which you can find in your [Twilio Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/ "Twilio Console"). This is how the AccessToken will tie a user's activity to a specific Twilio account.

### Step 2: Create an API Key and Secret

[step-2-api-key page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#step-2-api-key)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Next, you need to create an [API key](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v2010 "API key"). You can create API keys from the [Twilio Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/keys-credentials/api-keys?frameUrl=/console/project/api-keys "Twilio Console") or with the [REST API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v2010 "REST API").

**Note:** You can create Access Tokens using **Main** and **Standard** API Keys. Creating Access Tokens is not yet supported with Restricted API Keys.

(warning)

## Warning

If you are creating a key to use with Twilio Video, you must create it in the **US1** Region. [Learn more in the Twilio Video documentation.](https://www.twilio.com/docs/video/tutorials/user-identity-access-tokens#api-key-region "Learn more in the Twilio Video documentation.")

When you create the API key, you'll be shown the key's secret, which is used to sign the Access Token. For security, you will only be shown the secret at this time, so you need to store it with the key's SID in a secure location for the next step.

### Step 3: Generate an Access Token

[step-3-generate-token page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#step-3-generate-token)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Now use the information gathered in steps 1 and 2 to generate an Access Token using a Twilio SDK.

When creating an Access Token, you must provide:

- Your Twilio Account SID
- The API key SID and API key secret from Step 2

You can also optionally provide any of the following JWT configuration values.

| Parameter | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | The identity to associate with the Access Token. Typically, this will be a username in your system. Voice tokens may only contain alpha-numeric and underscore characters. | `user_name` |
| `ttl` | Time to live for the token, in seconds. | `3600` |
| `nbf` | Token not before time, or the time before which the token will NOT be accepted. Values are in Epoch time. | `1615404972` |
| `region` | The intended [Twilio Region](https://www.twilio.com/docs/global-infrastructure/understanding-twilio-regions "Twilio Region") for the token. Currently only supported for Voice tokens. | `us1` |

Each Twilio product will also require at least one "grant", which will provide product-specific abilities to the user associated with an Access Token.

(warning)

## Warning

Programmable Voice access tokens limit the number of concurrent sessions for a given identity to ten. When the 11th instance of the identity is registered the oldest registration is removed.
